title: LinksFunction
summary: Describe static document links on the root module.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: A zero-argument function returning arrays of string-valued link attributes. Links renders those descriptors as link elements in the document.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Place it on the root module and render Links in the root Layout head. This is separate from route metadata’s tagName: "link" descriptors. Asset URLs may be Vite imports or deployment URLs owned by the application.
